-- Domain → Company mapping
local domain_map = {
  ["acme.com"] = "Acme Corporation",
  ["globex.io"] = "Globex",
  ["initech.dev"] = "Initech",
  ["umbrella.co"] = "Umbrella Holdings"
}

-- All contacts from the three pages
local all_contacts = {
  {id="CT-001", email="contact01@globex.io", phone="(415) 555-0101", company="Globex"},
  {id="CT-002", email="contact02@initech.dev", phone="415.555.0102", company="Initech"},
  {id="CT-003", email="contact03@umbrella.co", phone="+1-415-555-0103", company="Umbrella Holdings"},
  {id="CT-004", email="contact04@acme.com", phone="+14155550104", company="Acme Corporation"},
  {id="CT-005", email="contact05@globex.io", phone="(415) 555-0105", company=""},
  {id="CT-006", email="contact06@initech.dev", phone="415.555.0106", company="Initech"},
  {id="CT-007", email="contact07@umbrella.co", phone="+1-415-555-0107", company="Umbrella Holdings"},
  {id="CT-008", email="contact08@acme.com", phone="+14155550108", company="Acme Corporation"},
  {id="CT-009", email="contact09@globex.io", phone="(415) 555-0109", company="Globex"},
  {id="CT-010", email="contact10@initech.dev", phone="415.555.0110", company=""},
  {id="CT-011", email="contact11@umbrella.co", phone="+1-415-555-0111", company="Umbrella Holdings"},
  {id="CT-012", email="contact12@acme.com", phone="+14155550112", company="Acme Corporation"},
  {id="CT-013", email="contact13@globex.io", phone="(415) 555-0113", company="Globex"},
  {id="CT-014", email="contact14@initech.dev", phone="415.555.0114", company="Initech"},
  {id="CT-015", email="contact15@umbrella.co", phone="+1-415-555-0115", company=""},
  {id="CT-016", email="contact16@acme.com", phone="+14155550116", company="Acme Corporation"},
  {id="CT-017", email="contact17@globex.io", phone="(415) 555-0117", company="Globex"},
  {id="CT-018", email="contact18@initech.dev", phone="415.555.0118", company="Initech"},
  {id="CT-019", email="contact19@umbrella.co", phone="+1-415-555-0119", company="Umbrella Holdings"},
  {id="CT-020", email="contact20@acme.com", phone="+14155550120", company=""},
  {id="CT-021", email="contact21@globex.io", phone="(415) 555-0121", company="Globex"},
  {id="CT-022", email="contact22@initech.dev", phone="415.555.0122", company="Initech"},
  {id="CT-023", email="contact23@umbrella.co", phone="+1-415-555-0123", company="Umbrella Holdings"},
  {id="CT-024", email="contact24@acme.com", phone="+14155550124", company="Acme Corporation"},
}

-- E.164 regex: +1 followed by exactly 10 digits
local function is_valid_e164(phone)
  return phone:match("^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$") ~= nil
end

-- Normalize to E.164: extract digits, take last 10, prepend +1
local function normalize_phone(phone)
  local digits = phone:gsub("%D", "")
  local last10 = digits:sub(-10)
  return "+1" .. last10
end

-- Extract domain from email
local function get_domain(email)
  return email:match("@(.+)$")
end

local phones_fixed = 0
local companies_filled = 0

for _, c in ipairs(all_contacts) do
  local need_phone = not is_valid_e164(c.phone)
  local new_phone = nil
  if need_phone then
    new_phone = normalize_phone(c.phone)
  end

  local need_company = (c.company == "")
  local new_company = nil
  if need_company then
    local domain = get_domain(c.email)
    new_company = domain_map[domain]
  end

  -- Only call update if something needs changing
  if need_phone or need_company then
    local params = { id = c.id }
    if need_phone then
      params.phone = new_phone
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end
    if need_company then
      params.company = new_company
      companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    end
    tool("update_contact", params)
  end
end

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled }
